entries.task_id: the buddha|was|wandering in the land of the kosalans together with a large saṅgha of mendicants when he arrived at a village of the kosalan brahmins named sālā
entries.description: the Buddha was wandering in the land of the Kosalans together with a large Saṅgha of mendicants when he arrived at a village of the Kosalan brahmins named Sālā
entries.subject: the Buddha
entries.object: wandering in the land of the Kosalans together with a large Saṅgha of mendicants when he arrived at a village of the Kosalan brahmins named Sālā

spans.text: At one time the Buddha was wandering in the land of the Kosalans together with a large Saṅgha of mendicants when he arrived at a village of the Kosalan brahmins named Sālā.

entries.task_id: ascetics and|brahmins|see that unskillful qualities are full of drawbacks
entries.description: ascetics and brahmins see that unskillful qualities are full of drawbacks
entries.subject: ascetics and
entries.object: see that unskillful qualities are full of drawbacks

spans.text: Because those ascetics and brahmins see that unskillful qualities are full of drawbacks, sordidness, and corruption, and that skillful qualities have the benefit and cleansing power of renunciation.

entries.task_id: but|let|us grant that those who say that there is no other world are correct
entries.description: But let us grant that those who say that there is no other world are correct
entries.subject: But
entries.object: us grant that those who say that there is no other world are correct

spans.text: Kāmaṁ kho pana māhu paro loko, hotu nesaṁ bhavataṁ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ saccaṁ vacanaṁ; But let us grant that those who say that there is no other world are correct.

entries.task_id: the ganges|giving|and sacrificing and encouraging others to do the same
entries.description: the Ganges giving and sacrificing and encouraging others to do the same
entries.subject: the Ganges
entries.object: and sacrificing and encouraging others to do the same

spans.text: If you were to go along the north bank of the Ganges giving and sacrificing and encouraging others to do the same, no merit comes of that, and no outcome of merit.
